description_en: Queries the list of node groups that match the filter conditions for the current user account
description_zh: 查询当前用户账号的符合过滤条件的节点分组列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-node-groups --fuzzy-name test --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodeGroups

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match string for the node group name
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_name

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match string for the JoinEUI used by the node group
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配节点分组所使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match string for the DevEUI of nodes in the group
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配分组中的节点DevEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the query, beginning from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of groups to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的分组数量上限，大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为CREATED_MILLIS, 表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order. Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of node groups that match the filter conditions
List.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的节点分组列表

ClassMode.description_en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the mode specified in the associated join permission
ClassMode.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所采用的LoRaWAN Class模式，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the node group, in UNIX timestamp format, measured in milliseconds
CreateMillis.description_zh: 节点分组的创建时间，格式为UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

DataDispatchConfig.description_en: The data forwarding configuration of the node group
DataDispatchConfig.description_zh: 节点分组的数据流转配置

Destination.description_en:
The data forwarding destination. Valid values:

IOT: forwards data to an IoT Platform product.
ONS: forwards data to a Message Queue (MQ) topic
Destination.description_zh:
数据流转目的地。取值：

IOT：数据流转到IoT的产品。
ONS：数据流转到MQ的Topic

IotProduct.description_en: The product information. This field is returned if the forwarding destination is an IoT Platform product
IotProduct.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是IoT产品，该字段存储产品信息

OnsTopics.description_en: The MQ topic information. This field is returned if the forwarding destination is MQ
OnsTopics.description_zh: 如果流转目的地是MQ，该字段存储MQ Topic信息

DownlinkRegionName.description_en: The region ID of the MQ downlink topic

UplinkRegionName.description_en: The region ID of the MQ uplink topic

DataDispatchEnabled.description_en: The enabled status of data forwarding for the node group. A value of true indicates enabled. A value of false indicates disabled
DataDispatchEnabled.description_zh: 节点分组的数据流转启停状态，true表示启用，false表示停用

FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_en: The frequency band ID used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the frequency band specified in the associated join permission
FreqBandPlanGroupId.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所采用的频段的频段ID，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的一致

JoinEui.description_en: The JoinEUI used by the nodes in the node group. This value is consistent with the JoinEUI specified in the associated join permission
JoinEui.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点所使用的JoinEUI，与分组所关联的入网凭证中指定的JoinEUI一致

JoinPermissionEnabled.description_en: The enabled status of the join permission associated with the node group. A value of true indicates enabled. A value of false indicates disabled
JoinPermissionEnabled.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的启停状态，true表示启用，false表示停用

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The ID of the join permission associated with the node group
JoinPermissionId.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的ID

JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_en:
If the associated join permission is a dedicated join permission, this field indicates the Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner.
If the associated join permission is a roaming join permission, this field is always set to AliCloud IoT
JoinPermissionOwnerAliyunId.description_zh:
如果关联的是专用入网凭证，该字段表示入网凭证的拥有者的阿里云账号ID。
如果关联的是泛在入网凭证，该字段的值恒为AliCloud IoT

JoinPermissionType.description_en:
The type of join permission associated with the node group. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated join permission.
ROAMING: roaming join permission
JoinPermissionType.description_zh:
与节点分组关联的入网凭证类型。取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证
ROAMING：泛在凭证

Locks.description_en: The list of operation locks associated with the node group
Locks.description_zh: 节点分组所关联的操作锁列表

CreateMillis.description_en: The creation time of the lock

Enabled.description_en: The enabled status of the lock

LockType.description_en: The type of the lock. Valid values: WRITE, which indicates that all write operations are locked, including editing and deletion
LockType.description_zh: 锁的类型。取值：WRITE，所有写操作都加锁，包括编辑、删除等

NodeGroupName.description_en: The name of the node group

NodesCnt.description_en: The number of nodes in the node group
NodesCnt.description_zh: 节点分组中的节点数量

RxDailySum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets for the current day associated with the join permission linked to the node group
RxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天上行数据包量

RxMonthSum.description_en: The number of uplink data packets for the current month associated with the join permission linked to the node group
RxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月上行数据包量

TxDailySum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets for the current day associated with the join permission linked to the node group
TxDailySum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当天下行数据包量

TxMonthSum.description_en: The number of downlink data packets for the current month associated with the join permission linked to the node group
TxMonthSum.description_zh: 与节点分组关联的入网凭证的当月下行数据包量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of node groups that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的节点分组总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
